goal: Track B strongest play: a policy candidate stronger than the research champion (H3 policy + c5 value) at the same S50 budget
question: with every other condition of A1 T kept, do train visit targets re-searched at S400 make the S50 policy stronger (than A1 T, and than the champion)

renjunet_cache.rule: prepare compares the actual cache with these committed values (never adopts new ones); train and val game_id sets disjoint

inputs.models_metadata: each best.json SHA and content (stage, config) checked with its checkpoint
inputs.consumed: reproduce and train check every input they consume against these expectations (never only the cache manifest) and train on exactly the checked objects

T.cycle: identical to C (rows, batches, order, generator, steps, coefficients)

replay.generator_seed: training seed + 1000003; draws the indices and the D4 symmetries; the cycle generator is untouched
replay.input: the same D4-transformed planes and legal mask for H3 and the student
replay.distribution: logits masked to -inf off the legal moves, then log_softmax (renormalised over legal moves)
replay.loss: per position sum over legal a of p_H3(a) (log p_H3(a) - log p_student(a)); mean over the 512 positions
replay.total: L = L_cycle (unchanged definition and batch mean) + mu * KL_replay
replay.added_to: the unchanged cycle loss (no cycle row is replaced)

S.cycle: arm T of A1 (the same rows, batches, order, generator, steps, replay, mu 0.5) with the train visit rows' targets re-searched at S400

replay.generator_seed: training seed + 1000003; draws the indices and the D4 symmetries; the cycle generator is untouched
replay.input: the same D4-transformed planes and legal mask for H3 and the student
replay.distribution: logits masked to -inf off the legal moves, then log_softmax (renormalised over legal moves)
replay.loss: per position sum over legal a of p_H3(a) (log p_H3(a) - log p_student(a)); mean over the 512 positions
replay.total: L = L_cycle (unchanged definition and batch mean) + mu * KL_replay
replay.added_to: the unchanged cycle loss (no cycle row is replaced)

training.selection: the c2 rule for both arms: guard (RenjuNet val top-1) within guard_drop of H3, lowest cycle val objective; the replay term is not in the selection metric

records.replay_kl: step mean during training and, at every evaluation, on the whole RenjuNet val split; both arms; no_grad and eval, outside the training path and its generators; never a selection metric

training.numeric: section determinism, for the gate and every main run

determinism.set_by_the_tool: torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True), cudnn.deterministic = True, cudnn.benchmark = False for the run, then restored
determinism.environment_rule: set before the process starts (cuBLAS reads it once); the tool refuses to start otherwise
determinism.checked: every value above at the start and unchanged at the end of each run; the other numeric settings (torch, CUDA, cuDNN, GPU, threads) recorded; every gate run and every main run must have the same full numeric settings
determinism.tf32: the cuDNN / matmul TF32 values are the PyTorch defaults the c2 run and the diagnosis ran with; checked, never changed
determinism.failure: an operation without a deterministic implementation stops the run (recorded as a failure); there is no fallback to non-deterministic settings

control.what: the A1 T checkpoints of the committed A1 seed records, unchanged (not trained again here, apart from the gate)

gate.run: T(20261024) through h7r_p1a1.execute with the A1 gate's numeric settings, on the c2 rows
gate.exact: fingerprints, the whole trainer record, P1 records, config, numeric settings, initial and selected state hashes, fixed-position log-probabilities: equal to the committed A1 T(20261024) seed record

search.reproduction_rule: the first 5 games of the R2-S400-PRE sample re-searched at S200 against the c2 S200 records (the G0 rule of h7c_retarget; mean values within 1e-5, everything else exact; every eligible ply compared)
search.scope: every eligible ply of the kept train-split games of the c2 rows (936 games)
search.records: runs/h7r/R2-S400-TRAIN/s400.jsonl, purpose r2-s400-train (the label step refuses it); resumed records get the same checks as new ones
search.estimate: about 4.0 hours for the train scope (R2-S400-PRE ratio method)

rows.rule: the c2 rows file with each train visit row's target replaced by h7c_retarget.retarget_target of its S400 record; no S400 mass keeps the S200 target (marked s200_kept, counted); no row added (S400-only targets counted); val, proof and masked rows, row order and every other field unchanged
rows.checks: before training: the file is its recorded SHA-256 and passes the row check again (every field but target / s400 equal to the c2 row; every replaced target recomputed from the S400 records)
rows.provenance: run records and checkpoint metadata carry the c2 rows, candidate rows and S400 record SHA-256

stages.train: 3 seeds of S through h7r_p1a1.execute (kind T) with the gate's numeric settings; each committed alone
stages.arena: the v2 Arena contract, play, judge

arena.pairing: per suite, S and T play the same openings with the same seed

statistics.stratified: resample openings within each development suite (300 and 300); the S and T results of a drawn opening move together
statistics.combined: 0.5 x O1-dev-a mean + 0.5 x O1-dev-b mean (fixed weights)
statistics.sensitivity: class-level stratified bootstrap (classes resampled within a suite, all their openings together, the same 50:50 weights); reported, not read

D'.what: S - T pair-score differences on the same openings: the effect of the target change

P'.what: S vs champion: combined score - 0.5: the entry rule of the next stage

reading.next: P' STRONGER: the candidate goes to the independent confirmation stage; no champion change here
reading.planning_values: SE about 1.04%p, +2.05%p observed and +2.93%p true effect at 80% power: planning values, never thresholds

data_rule: RenjuNet-derived data, caches and models stay under data/ or runs/; only hashes and numbers are committed

identity.experiment_sha256: sha256 of the canonical JSON of this contract without "approved"; links prepare, train, link and Arena records
identity.contract_file_sha256: recorded separately by every run (changes with approval commits)

invariance: every command records HEAD (clean), the contract file, the sources and the files it reads at its start and checks them again right before it publishes; a change publishes nothing
